zh-CN.Long before calculators, carpenters laid: 楼梯尺寸应从完成后的地面到完成后的地面测量。忽略地板、平台或铺面厚度，会让第一步或最后一步不一致。
zh-CN.Set The Stair Gauges To Rise And Run: 平衡踏步高和踏面深度
zh-CN.First, work out your unit rise and unit: 踏步高、踏面深度和总进深共同决定楼梯是否舒适。一个小误差会重复到整段楼梯上，所以需要先算清楚。
zh-CN.Place the square on the 2x12 with both g: 在决定楼梯梁之前，要检查水平空间、洞口、转角、门扇、扶手和净空。能走通的楼梯不一定安装得下。
zh-CN.The bottom of the stringer gets a level: 对复杂现场，先画一根样板楼梯梁并现场核对，再批量切割。一次验证比整批返工便宜得多。
zh-CN.Drop The Stringer For Equal Risers: Drop The Stringer For Equal Risers
zh-CN.Here is the step most often missed: the: Here is the step most often missed: the bottom riser must be cut shorter by one tread thickness so that, once the treads are installed, every finished riser is equal. This dropped-stringer adjustment trips up many first-timers. Subtract the tread thickness from the bottom rise before cutting.
zh-CN.Cut the notches with a circular saw up t: Cut the notches with a circular saw up to the corner of each notch, then finish the inside corner with a handsaw or jigsaw so you do not overcut and weaken the throat. Overcutting past the corner is a common mistake that quietly reduces strength. Stop the power saw at the line and finish by hand.
zh-CN.Verify, Then Use It As A Template: Verify, Then Use It As A Template
zh-CN.Test-fit the first stringer in the openi: Test-fit the first stringer in the opening before cutting the rest. Check that treads will be level and the top and bottom cuts seat properly. Once it is right, trace it to mark the others. A calculator or the Stringer app can confirm your framing-square numbers, including the dropped first step, before you commit the cuts.
